_comment: Handgepflegt (Issue #99): Englischer 'Was ist neu'-Text für GENAU die Version im Feld 'version'. Der CHANGELOG ist nur deutsch und wird nicht maschinell übersetzt (Owner-Entscheidung) - 'title' und 'en' werden beim Release von Hand geschrieben, sinngemäß zum deutschen CHANGELOG-Abschnitt derselben Version. Der Generator (scripts/generate-whatsnew.mjs) übernimmt 'en' NUR, wenn 'version' hier exakt zur aktuellen APP_VERSION passt - sonst bleibt EN absichtlich leer, damit eine vergessene Übersetzung nicht lautlos durchrutscht (siehe web/scripts/check-whatsnew.mjs).
en:
No migration, no change to your data. Card images from the card databases are now fetched and stored by your PokéCollect server; your browser no longer talks to those other sites for these images.

• Important if Caddy sits in front: your Caddyfile needs the new handle /bild-spiegel/* block to the API before you update (templates and instructions under deploy/). Without it these images stay empty.
• Changed: card images, Pokédex placeholders and sealed images come from your own server. On first view an image appears with a short delay while it is fetched; after that it comes from storage.
• Changed: these images come in original size, no longer scaled down, which uses more data on your phone than in v1.10.0.
• Changed: these images are probably missing offline when the PokéCollect server runs on its own address, because the app does not keep them for later.
• Changed: image addresses you enter by hand only show from the known card databases and the Pokédex images on pokemon.com. The card page names the allowed sites and warns when an address will stay empty.
• Known limits: catalog, target view and scan still load images directly from the card databases. The image storage has no size limit; it is not part of the backup because every image can be fetched again.
• Security: the image optimizer only processes your own images. The new image path needs no login because an image tag cannot send one, but it only serves addresses the server signed itself, only from the fixed image sites, and follows no redirects.
• Maintenance: several tests now really check what their name says, the commit guard's self-check is stricter, and deploy.sh skips the ZFS snapshot folder .zfs when setting file permissions.
title: External images through your own server
